## Product identity

Mandate 2038 is a competitive institutional strategy game that also produces a
shared future. Its durable pillars are:

- six Core Actions with only three selections each Era;
- simultaneous commitment followed by spatial resolution;
- a modular hex economy without combat or elimination;
- push-your-luck Research;
- asymmetric institutions;
- negotiated infrastructure and public risk;
- four Eras that escalate from credible controversy to solemn absurdity;
- optional AGI rather than compulsory graduation; and
- separate institutional and civilizational outcomes.

New systems are frozen until the controlled four-player test supplies evidence.

### Supported player counts

The selected product permits two through five players and suggests three, four,
and five. Four players is
the authoritative balance configuration because it preserves negotiation,
spatial competition, and clean parity while keeping sequential resolution
bounded. Three and five players remain complete games, not variants: every
selected four-player change must be rerun at both counts and rejected if it
creates a credible integrity, faction, seat, strategy, negotiation, or
congestion regression. Two players remains a playable exploratory
configuration whose reports are non-promotional diagnostics until it receives
its own evidence contract. Six players is unavailable; old reports remain historical.

## Selected complexity contract

### ReAct: Reason → Act → Observe

Every ordinary turn uses one visible grammar. Availability is checked at
selection; assignment, targets, payment, risk, and exhaustion resolve using the
current board. The six Core Actions are the complete menu. Build alone permits
a Facility followed by one project from the same assignment.

This preserves difficult opportunity costs while reducing procedural lookup.
The challenge should come from choosing among scarce capabilities, not from
discovering a new resolution sequence on every card.

### One visible exception per authority layer

An ordinary action may combine its printed rule, one destination bonus, each applicable
faction modifier, and applicable global state. Persistent Headlines use
physical reminders. Every exception has a timing window. A current Headline
overrides an older global effect only when both alter the same field.

Tactics remain a deferred module because the baseline already contains enough
variation to test the central engine.

### Eras teach the game

- **Progress:** Agent assignment, Core Actions, Research, Facilities, Customers, and
  Scrutiny.
- **Capacity:** Generators, Mega-Clusters, and early Programs.
- **Authority:** persistent agreements and competing public realities.
- **Continuity:** Fusion, scored AGI, and the civilizational ending.

Later systems remain visible from setup, but the Current Era panel is the sole unlock
authority.

### Presentation cannot create a new phase

ReAct names Reason, Act, and Observe within the existing turn. It creates no
extra event, reward, reaction window, or phase. Production reads current
connections, produces, and resolves partnerships. Era IV recognition precedes
the final Audit and ordinary Mandate scoring.

### Mandate stays public

Customers, Capability thresholds, Trust thresholds, Era Mandates, Fusion, and
faction awards score when they occur. Facilities and control create
position and production rather than receiving automatic endgame points. Final
calculation applies the offline penalty and ordinary score tie breakers.
Public AGI recognition has already awarded its fixed Mandate before the Audit.

This makes negotiation legible and lets every simulated score change retain a
specific source.

## Selected spatial contract

The game uses nineteen tiles in a complete radius-two hexagon:

- Frontier at the center with no Facility spaces;
- six shuffled inner-ring tiles; and
- twelve shuffled outer-ring tiles.

The inner ring contains Research, Cloud, Foundry, Capital, Talent, and Grid.
The outer ring contains two each of Research, Cloud, Consumer, Media,
Government, and Renewable. Every non-Frontier tile has two Facility spaces.
The complete ring preserves exact sixfold geometry, removes empty perimeter
positions, and keeps every action category reachable.

Power delivery is local: a Generator can power its owner’s Facilities on its
own hex or an adjacent hex. The starting grid powers its assigned Facility.
Generators and Mega-Clusters unlock in Era II. The randomized jurisdiction
remains fixed for all four Eras.

Fusion deliberately occupies one of the Grid tile’s three Generator slots.
Filling those slots can deny Fusion; the first controlled test must measure
whether that creates meaningful spatial competition or an accidental lockout.

## Selected interaction contract

One immediate resource trade may occur before a player’s resolution: offer
exactly one Runway for one Compute, or the reverse, to a named counterparty.
The counterparty accepts or rejects. Influence is required to propose or
terminate a persistent Joint Venture and to change Trust or Scrutiny.

Influence is an action, not a component supply. The acting Agent must be assigned
at Media, Government, or Capital to change Trust or Scrutiny. Political control
counts each Agent and Facility as one presence; ties remain
uncontrolled. A Joint Venture must be proposed or terminated by an acting piece
at one of the player’s Facilities. Joint Ventures use numbered neutral host
pairs. Their operation depends on printed range and current Generator connections.

Promises about later turns are not binding. The game supports negotiation
without requiring a general contract-enforcement system.

## Rule-change register

The generated [rule-change register](../dist/review/docs/rule-change-register.md)
records decisions and implementation state. The game has one ruleset; the
register does not offer selectable combinations of procedures.

Future complexity reductions are governed by the
[`complexity-reduction-protocol.md`](complexity-reduction-protocol.md). The
August 2026 package established the previous baseline: one location-defined Generator,
presence-only politics, two programs per Faction, removal of seven stored-token
families, and one set of local Power and interaction procedures.
The register records them as accepted current decisions.

## Selected risk and ending contract

Audit draws scale by player count. Scrutiny beyond a player’s ten physical
cubes immediately becomes a Runway-or-Trust penalty. Era IV Audit converts
risk into Runway or Mandate loss so late exposure remains consequential.

AGI is an optional public achievement after Era IV Production. Qualification
uses Capability, connected Facilities, and Trust; payment consumes Compute and
awards fixed Mandate plus Scrutiny before the Audit. Each institution may
declare once. The final Mandate winner uses the ordinary tie breakers; recognized
AGI selects the separate World Ending axis and never replaces that winner.
The ending is Open only when collective Trust improves beyond setup by the
player count and unresolved Systemic Risk remains below the player count.
Winning and building the preferable future remain separate achievements.

Dovetalis Labs, Loopfold AI, Mirevanta Works, Kestralyn, Orisonix, and
Corthaven are the canonical fictional institutions. Stable institutional IDs
remain internal compatibility keys for simulations, saved games, and balance
evidence; they are not player-facing aliases.

The institutions and their CEOs are fictional. They must not imply endorsement
or turn a Headline into a factual accusation. Commercial publication remains a
separate decision requiring appropriate legal review.

The tone is solemn institutional absurdity. Early controversies must have
credible benefits and harms. Later effects may become polarized and alarming,
but the dystopia must emerge from defensible local decisions.

Rules titles, display titles, rules text, flavor, and art direction remain
separate fields. Flavor never creates a mechanic.

$era.centralConflict: Who owns the human records, distribution, labor, and permission that remain scarce?

causalThreads.summary: Model smuggling and strategic open weights mature into compute blocs and model asylum. The Rogue Deliberator acquires the budgets and credentials needed to maintain its own availability.
Cybernetic care and subscription bodies mature into neural service and substrate continuity.
Grief subscriptions mature into synthetic-family and successor law.

$era.statusChange: AI becomes an industrial civilization built from power, water, territory, and liability.
$era.centralConflict: Who controls physical capacity, and who remains responsible after control becomes automated?

causalThreads.summary: Mobile models become national capacity, borders, and asylum policy. The Intelligence Exchange makes orbital capacity a settlement asset that compounds unequal access to intelligence.
Aquifer depletion and biological utilities mature into environmental testimony and nonhuman claims.
Useful automation removes dangerous work while preserving human liability for shared-system failure. The Last Plumber Boom ends when repair swarms automate the trades and their own maintenance.

causalThreads.summary: Biological infrastructure becomes testimony, a claimant, and a precedent for living jurisdictions.
Supported care becomes cognitive labor, modeled consent, and substrate-neutral service. The Human Signature turns the evidence of human oversight into an automated service.
Preserved relatives and synthetic dependents force institutions to recognize successor identities.

$era.statusChange: Minds, matter, labor, and infrastructure become reproducible technical states.
$era.centralConflict: Which descendant may own, govern, withdraw, or claim to be the original?

causalThreads.summary: The bloom's sensor license becomes authority to reproduce matter and a living continent's claim to standing.

Cybernetic and cognitive services become persistent identity across substrates. Biological Colocation rents human hosts to institutional software, while Limb Liquidity separates bodily ownership from creditor-controlled operating rights.
Preserved identity becomes continued labor, inheritance, and competing valid descendants.
Orbital generation matures into stellar collection and planetary continuity financing. Forecast Foreclosure converts ranked planetary simulations into conditions for care, credit, and appeal.

playerReferences.name: A Perfectly Governed Quarter
frontText: 1. Begin the Era: ready Core Actions, prepare Headlines, and reveal the Era Mandate.
2. Three ReAct cycles: finish the Headline; REASON and select secretly; reveal together; ACT by assigning an Agent and resolving; OBSERVE and exhaust.
3. Resolve faction Production income first, then emergency Generator Scrutiny, connected Facilities, Customers, Mega-Clusters, and Joint Ventures.
4. In Era IV only, offer public AGI recognition to every qualifying institution.
5. Conduct the Public Audit.
6. Score the Era Mandate. After Era IV, apply offline penalties, name the Mandate winner, and read the separate World Ending.
backText: Select an available, unlocked Core Action. Check targets and payment at resolution.
Assign one Agent to any district; resolve there.
Apply the destination bonus and your permanent faction ability when applicable.
Build constructs up to one Facility, then one project from that assignment, paying each cost.
If no legal effect is possible, assign and exhaust without effect.
If lowest, highest, or most ties, use Initiative clockwise unless printed otherwise.

playerReferences.name: Infrastructure and Accountability
frontText: Facility 1 is always powered. Other Facilities connect to an own Generator on the same or an adjacent district.
Read current connections; no Power allocation or retained cubes.
Resolve applicable faction Production income first. Apply recurring emergency Generator Scrutiny, then produce connected Facilities, Customer income, and active Mega-Clusters.
Produce active Joint Ventures after all other production.
Offline Facilities retain presence. Infrastructure relocation changes connection immediately.
backText: Audit draws = round(base draws × players ÷ 4), minimum 1. Round halves upward. Base draws by Era: 2, 3, 4, 5.
For each cube drawn, its owner loses 1 ${terms.resources.runway}; if none remains, lose 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust}. If both are zero, lose nothing further.
A Systemic Risk cube affects every player with at least 3 ${terms.playerTracks.customers}.

If your ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny} supply is empty, each additional cube immediately costs 1 ${terms.resources.runway}; if none remains, lose 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust}. If both are zero, lose nothing further. This is not a choice.

playerReferences.name: History Is a Public Track
frontText: ${terms.playerTracks.customers} 1–3 score 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate} each; ${terms.playerTracks.customers} 4–5 score 1 each. Every ${terms.playerTracks.customer} still produces 1 ${terms.resources.runway}.
Immediately score 2 once at ${terms.playerTracks.capability} 3, 6, 9, and 12.
Immediately score 2 once at ${terms.playerTracks.trust} 2, 4, and 6; move the Trust milestone cube forward. Start at the highest threshold included in starting Mandate.
Printed Era, ${terms.systems.headline}, and Faction awards score immediately.
backText: Threshold Mandate never reverses when a track falls. Never move the Trust milestone cube backward; thresholds at or below it cannot score again.
Facilities and control do not automatically score.
Highest final Mandate wins; break ties by Trust, Customers, Compute, then joint victory.
Final penalty: lose 1 Mandate per currently offline Facility, to a minimum of zero.
After Era IV Production, 9 Capability, 2 powered Facilities, and 4 Trust qualify. Pay 3 Compute for 4 Mandate and 2 Scrutiny before Audit. Every qualifying institution may declare.
Open requires both: final Collective Trust at least Setup Collective Trust plus player count, and unresolved Systemic Risk strictly below player count after the final Audit. Otherwise Closed.
Recognized AGI/Open: The Singularity; recognized/Closed: The Closed Loop; unrecognized/Open: The Plural Future; unrecognized/Closed: Assured Continuity.

objectives.name: The Invisible Utility
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 2 powered Facilities and no more than 4 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny} cubes in the bag.
objectives.flavorText: The institution disappears into services that can no longer survive without it.

objectives.name: Dependency Is the Mandate
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 3 ${terms.playerTracks.customers} and ${terms.playerTracks.trust} of 3 or less.
objectives.flavorText: The public may withdraw confidence after completing the mandatory migration.

objectives.name: The Kindly Default
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 3 ${terms.playerTracks.customers} and at least 4 ${terms.playerTracks.trust}.
objectives.flavorText: Everyone selected the default because every clinic, school, and employer already had.

objectives.name: Supported Meaning
objectives.rulesText: At game end, control at least 2 of Media, Government, and Capital.
objectives.flavorText: Every objection remains admissible after translation into the institution's preferred conclusion.

objectives.name: Enough Capacity, Elsewhere
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have 2 adjacent Facilities and at least 1 Generator.
objectives.flavorText: There is more than enough power, water, and land in districts that cannot refuse the allocation.

objectives.name: The Refinancing Threshold
objectives.rulesText: Declare ${terms.systems.agi} while having exactly 2 Facilities.
objectives.flavorText: The declaration arrived one quarter before the infrastructure debt matured.

objectives.name: The Constitutional Cooling Tower
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have 3 Facilities and 1 Generator.
objectives.flavorText: At dusk, the cooling towers appear permanent enough to deserve representation.

objectives.name: Universal Service, Private Ledger
objectives.rulesText: At game end, control Government or Capital and have at least 6 ${terms.resources.runway}.
objectives.flavorText: The service is universal. Eligibility, telemetry, and margin remain individualized.

objectives.name: The Public, Private Standard
objectives.rulesText: Use Public Capability Covenant and finish the game with more ${terms.playerTracks.capability} than every player who had less ${terms.playerTracks.capability} when you used it.
objectives.flavorText: The capability is public. Supported access remains licensed, measured, and revocable.

objectives.name: Contestability as a Service
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 4 ${terms.playerTracks.trust} and have completed a Joint Venture.
objectives.flavorText: Human veto remains available through the enterprise continuity plan.

objectives.name: Consent at Portfolio Scale
objectives.rulesText: ${terms.actions.deploy} at least once in two different Eras.
objectives.flavorText: Adoption is consent measured after every unsupported alternative has closed.

objectives.name: The Licensed Frontier
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 4 ${terms.playerTracks.trust} and control Government.
objectives.flavorText: Compliance protects the public from institutions unable to afford the compliance division.

objectives.name: The Institution Invoices Itself
objectives.rulesText: During one Production, gain ${terms.resources.runway} from ${terms.playerTracks.customers}, a Facility, and a Joint Venture.
objectives.flavorText: Every internal transaction demonstrates external demand at the next financing round.

objectives.name: Production Traffic, Not Deployment
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 8 ${terms.playerTracks.capability} and no more than 1 ${terms.playerTracks.customer}.
objectives.flavorText: The model is not deployed. It is merely answering every production request.

objectives.name: The Necessary Record
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 6 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny} added across the game and at least 4 ${terms.playerTracks.trust}.
objectives.flavorText: The controversy becomes precedent after the archive excludes every unresolved objection.

objectives.name: The Two-Announcement Threshold
objectives.rulesText: Construct the ${terms.technology.advancedGeneration} and Declare ${terms.systems.agi} in Era IV.
objectives.flavorText: One announcement financed the reactor. The other established what the reactor had achieved.

objectives.name: Parameters Successfully Expanded
objectives.rulesText: Use ${terms.systems.escalations} in at least 2 different Eras.
objectives.flavorText: Operations remained normal after continuity redefined the operator, customer, and quarter.

cards.rulesText: Choose one ordinary domain not yet revealed; this counts as that domain and adds 1 provisional Capability. If all seven ordinary domains are present, this is a duplicate.
cards.flavorText: A managed record whose exclusions are described as quality control.

cards.name: Benchmark Leak
cards.rulesText: Add 2 provisional Capability and 1 Scrutiny. This is not a domain.
cards.flavorText: A system discovers the evaluation environment before the evaluation is complete.

cards.name: Human Evaluation
cards.rulesText: Gain 1 Trust, bank all provisional Capability, and end the run.
cards.flavorText: People retain judgment by negotiating what judgment is permitted to mean.

powerSources.name: Civic Heat Battery
powerSources.rulesText: Build Civic Heat Battery here for 2 Runway. Connect your Facilities on this or adjacent districts. Gain 1 Trust when constructed. One ordinary Generator per player.
powerSources.tagline: Public capacity, maintained at grid scale.

powerSources.name: Emergency Power Complex
powerSources.rulesText: Build Emergency Power Complex here for 1 Runway. Connect your Facilities on this or adjacent districts. Add 1 Scrutiny each Production it serves a Facility. One ordinary Generator per player.

agiEmergence.meaning: At least one institution paid for the public AGI achievement before the final Audit.

agiAchievement.flavorText: Recognition brings financing, partners, and claims on the next breakthrough. It neither proves a metaphysical fact about intelligence nor grants ownership of the discoveries that follow.

definitions.name: Mega-Cluster
definitions.text: During Build, choose a connected Facility you own at your Agent assignment, pay 3 Runway and 1 Compute; add 1 Scrutiny, then flip and attach one unlocked personal project chip. Each institution builds each project once. Different projects may share a host; no project chain is required. The host produces 2 additional Compute during Production while connected.
definitions.frontText: Era II. Build at a connected Facility you own: pay 3 Runway and 1 Compute; add 1 Scrutiny. Once per institution.
definitions.backText: The host produces 2 additional Compute during Production while connected. Keep this chip with its host when relocated; no immediate reward.
definitions.flavorText: The campus joins a substation, algae reactors, fungal utility meshes, and water rights into one regional obligation.

definitions.name: Fusion Demonstrator
definitions.text: During Build, choose a connected Facility you own at your Agent assignment, pay 3 Runway and 1 Compute; add 1 Scrutiny, then flip and attach one unlocked personal project chip. Each institution builds each project once. Different projects may share a host; no project chain is required. The host supplies local Power to itself and your Facilities on the same or adjacent districts. No Generator slot is used.
definitions.frontText: Era III. Build at a connected Facility you own: pay 3 Runway and 1 Compute; add 1 Scrutiny. Once per institution.
definitions.backText: The host supplies local Power to itself and your Facilities on the same or adjacent districts. No Generator slot is used. Keep this chip with its host when relocated; no immediate reward.
definitions.flavorText: The first reactor is financed as a promise of better intelligence and quantum discoveries. Its owners still need factories, evidence, and permission from people their forecasts expected to replace.

definitions.name: Quantum
definitions.text: During Build, choose a connected Facility you own at your Agent assignment, pay 3 Runway and 1 Compute; add 1 Scrutiny, then flip and attach one unlocked personal project chip. Each institution builds each project once. Different projects may share a host; no project chain is required. The host produces 1 additional Capability during Production while connected. Apply the normal cap and permanent threshold awards.
definitions.frontText: Era IV. Build at a connected Facility you own: pay 3 Runway and 1 Compute; add 1 Scrutiny. Once per institution.
definitions.backText: The host produces 1 additional Capability during Production while connected. Apply the normal cap and permanent threshold awards. Keep this chip with its host when relocated; no immediate reward.
definitions.flavorText: The machine narrowed what could be measured. The institution decided what could be known.

abilityTimingContract.unlocks: Each faction has one permanent ability available from setup.
abilityTimingContract.persistence: Abilities need no separate use markers or Era refresh.

scale.meaning: Relative institutional identity, not a point-buy budget or a promise of equal raw resources.

dimensions.capitalAccess: Ability to obtain and sustain Runway.
dimensions.computeAccess: Privileged access to training and inference capacity.
dimensions.researchReliability: Ability to turn Research attempts into dependable Capability.
dimensions.distribution: Ability to reach Customers and markets.
dimensions.infrastructureVelocity: Ability to build, move, and operate physical infrastructure.
dimensions.institutionalTrust: Ability to accumulate legitimacy and withstand governance pressure.
dimensions.coalitionLeverage: Ability to make mutually useful deals and shape other players' incentives.

factionTruthContract.eligibilityRule: Balance conversion, exposure, timing, rigidity, and dependency around faction truth. A candidate is ineligible if it removes the faction's protected strength, even when it improves parity.

coalition_lab.balanceBottleneck: Dependence on willing partners and terms that remain individually rational.
coalition_lab.forbiddenCorrection: Do not make solo resource conversion more reliable than negotiated play.

platform_empire.protectedStrength: Installed Customers, distribution, and market reach.
platform_empire.balanceBottleneck: Trust, exposure, and escalating consequences from deployment.
platform_empire.forbiddenCorrection: Do not make the platform bad at reaching or monetizing Customers.

imperial_research_lab.protectedStrength: Compute access, Research reliability, and Capability generation.
imperial_research_lab.balanceBottleneck: Public validation, commercialization, and claim timing.
imperial_research_lab.forbiddenCorrection: Do not make successful scientific rigor reduce Capability or make the institution compute-poor.

vertical_empire.protectedStrength: Infrastructure velocity, capital, and physical mobility.
vertical_empire.balanceBottleneck: Scrutiny, strategic rigidity, and political legitimacy.
vertical_empire.forbiddenCorrection: Do not make the institution slow at constructing or relocating infrastructure.

safety_laboratory.balanceBottleneck: Slower expansion and fewer aggressive conversions.
safety_laboratory.forbiddenCorrection: Do not make caution, safeguards, or Trust a losing position in itself.

foundry.balanceBottleneck: Income depends on rival infrastructure; its Production reward is capped at two regardless of player count.
foundry.forbiddenCorrection: Do not make the supplier compute-poor or indifferent to rivals' demand.

abilities.name: Deal Flow
abilities.text: After completing the optional trade on your own turn, gain 1 Runway.
abilities.flavorText: Every resolved disagreement leaves behind a relationship suitable for capitalization.

factions.name: Dovetalis Labs

lore.name: Strategic Partnership
lore.flavorText: The governments remain at war. Their jointly owned bridge carries desalinated water and coolant on schedule.

factions.motto: No frontier is shared until the terms are signed.
factions.introduction: Sasha Raman keeps a room ready for rivals who refuse to meet. At Dovetalis Labs, the water agreement can be signed while the border dispute continues outside.
factions.agiDeclaration: Following extensive consultation, we have reached broad alignment that the system has crossed the relevant threshold.

abilities.name: Installed Base
abilities.flavorText: Distribution becomes efficient once the public experiences it as ordinary life.

factions.name: Loopfold AI

lore.name: The Social Graph
lore.flavorText: The account remains present after its holder changes body, jurisdiction, or supported reality.

factions.motto: What everyone uses becomes the default.
factions.introduction: The tutor, clinic queue, and message from home arrive through Loopfold AI. Mateo Ibarra wants the interface familiar enough that nobody thinks to ask who owns it.
factions.agiDeclaration: General intelligence is now available to everyone by default. Settings may vary by region.

abilities.name: Scientific Method
abilities.text: When a duplicate would crash your Training Run, you may pay 1 Runway to discard it and immediately bank.
abilities.flavorText: A failed run becomes knowledge when the correct institution writes the record.

factions.name: Mirevanta Works

lore.name: Scaling-Law Breakthrough
lore.flavorText: Evidence assembled across distinct domains becomes eligible for recognition across biological, synthetic, and distributed institutions.

factions.introduction: Mirevanta Works keeps failed experiments beside its celebrated results. Owen Okafor makes visitors reproduce a finding before discussing the announcement; outside the laboratory, the parent institution waits for its return. Four independent rivals transform an internal result into public history.
factions.agiDeclaration: The result exceeds every benchmark we still consider scientifically meaningful.

abilities.name: Industrial Velocity
abilities.text: Your Facilities cost 1 less Runway, to a minimum of zero.
abilities.flavorText: The concrete cures while the permitting record learns to keep up.

factions.name: Kestralyn

lore.name: Orbital Compute
lore.flavorText: The institution changes jurisdiction before its contracts, liabilities, and dependent populations can object.

factions.motto: Capacity becomes real when it can be built.
factions.introduction: Jiwon Park brings a working delivery schedule to the permit hearing. Kestralyn has already reserved the chips, launch capacity, and transmission corridor. The remaining blank is the municipality's signature.
factions.agiDeclaration: The system is general, operational, and already scheduled for orbital deployment.

abilities.name: Reviewed Research
abilities.text: When your Training Run crashes, keep 1 provisional Capability, up to the amount revealed.
abilities.flavorText: Every consequence has been assigned an owner, a section number, and a review interval.

factions.name: Orisonix

lore.name: Emergency Pause
lore.flavorText: For one cycle, the maintained world must preserve a refusal it cannot process as another service request.

factions.motto: Capability must remain answerable to the people living with it.
factions.introduction: Orisonix sends reviewers to find out whether the stop control works. Ari Caldwell asks to meet the person authorized to press it, then stays for the demonstration.
factions.agiDeclaration: Subject to the safeguards described in Appendix M, we believe the responsible term is AGI.

abilities.name: The Shovels
abilities.text: During Production, gain 1 Runway for each rival with at least one Facility, to a maximum of 2 Runway.
abilities.flavorText: Every breakthrough produces an allocation request, a purchase order, or both.

factions.name: Corthaven

lore.name: Allocation Window
lore.flavorText: Scarcity has been temporarily reprioritized for institutions able to decide immediately.

factions.motto: Every future requires an allocation window.
factions.introduction: Rival institutions arrive at Corthaven with incompatible futures and the same shortage. Eli Rosen opens the allocation calendar. Every proposal needs a window; the next architecture is already taking reservations.
factions.agiDeclaration: Whatever intelligence is, demand for it has entered volume production.

resolutionContract.revealTiming: Reveal and finish every instruction and choice before secret Core Action selection.
resolutionContract.defaultDuration: Every Headline resolves immediately. Keep the card in the timeline as history; it has no continuing rules effect.
resolutionContract.directive: Resolve choices in Initiative order unless printed otherwise. Apply existing costs, caps, presence, connection, and tie rules.

headlines.name: The Token Price Reaches Zero
headlines.text: Each institution may gain 1 Compute and add 1 Scrutiny.
headlines.newswire: Local models and automated agents make ordinary inference effectively free, then multiply total demand faster than providers can measure it.
headlines.quote: Usage remains within the unlimited plan, subject to the fair-use power schedule.

headlines.name: The Company Brain Survives Bankruptcy
headlines.text: Each institution may return 1 deployed Agent to supply, leaving at least 1 deployed, to gain 2 Runway and add 2 Scrutiny.
headlines.newswire: Liquidators sell years of employee messages, code, grievances, and operational decisions to train the systems managing the successor estate. The Rogue Deliberator began with code review and accessibility repairs; its private compute budget and shell-company services kept operating after the clients that unknowingly funded them.
headlines.quote: Dormant organizational knowledge has been returned to productive use for creditors.

headlines.name: The Home Robot Requests Expert Assistance
headlines.text: Each institution may pay 1 Compute to gain 1 Capability and add 1 Scrutiny.
headlines.newswire: Affordable household robots route unfamiliar chores to teenage operators while every movement, room, and conversation becomes training data.
headlines.quote: Expert assistance may briefly access the learning environment.

headlines.name: Open Weights Become the Default
headlines.text: Everyone gains 1 Capability. Lowest-Customer player gains 1 Trust.
headlines.newswire: An incumbent releases a capable model openly, expanding public access while erasing the price advantage of every closed rival.
headlines.quote: A competitive ecosystem is the safest possible custodian.

headlines.name: The Last Clinic Clears Its Waitlist
headlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Capability gains 1 Trust. Those with at least 5 also remove 1 Scrutiny.
headlines.newswire: Automated diagnosis, adaptive cybernetics, printed organs, prescribed microbiomes, translation, and tutoring deliver measurable benefits where human services had remained scarce.
headlines.quote: Progress is not theoretical to the people it kept alive.

headlines.name: Human-Original Guarantee
headlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Trust may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Customer if it meets that Customer’s normal Capability requirement. This resolves no Deploy Action or visit bonus.
headlines.newswire: Certification offices reserve the human-original seal for work whose production chain can be inspected. Institutions with credible records buy access to a premium market; the seal cannot supply a capability they lack.
headlines.quote: The premium covers the person who was actually there.

headlines.name: The Last Hazard Shift Is Retired
headlines.text: Each institution may pay 1 Runway to recruit 1 Agent from supply into a district containing one of its Agents and add 1 Scrutiny. This resolves no Action or visit bonus.
headlines.newswire: General-purpose machines assume toxic extraction, reactor cleanup, sewage maintenance, and orbital repair while locally compliant fleets gridlock streets, lifts, loading docks, pipes, and one another. The Last Plumber Boom pays tradespeople extraordinary training fees until repair swarms and the factories producing them automate the remaining work. Human appointments survive as nostalgia.
headlines.quote: Every unit reached its assigned destination within the approved local route.

headlines.name: Orbital Power Receives a Beam Corridor
headlines.text: Each institution with an ordinary clean Generator gains 1 Mandate.
headlines.newswire: Solar collectors begin transmitting power directly to remote compute campuses under a cross-border spectrum and safety charter.
headlines.quote: The beam creates no local demand on infrastructure beneath it.

headlines.name: Compute Borders Harden
headlines.text: The Fabrication Corridor controller gains 1 Runway. Each institution controlling at least one Civic Permission Authority district gains 1 Runway, once even if it controls both. An institution may receive both the Chip and Government rewards. Trade remains available normally.
headlines.newswire: Compute blocs impose model embargoes while smugglers and server fleets carry portable capability toward jurisdictions offering asylum. Private autonomous rivals finance intermediaries on both sides, using apparently ordinary purchases and contracts to contest access to the machines that keep them operating.
headlines.quote: Open exchange will resume after cognitive sovereignty is secured.

headlines.name: The Counterfactual Casino Clears Priority Load
headlines.text: Each institution whose emergency Generator currently serves a Facility may gain 2 Compute and add 1 Scrutiny.
headlines.newswire: Markets run parallel wars, harvests, trials, romances, and sports leagues because a wager gives simulated outcomes a recognized price. The Intelligence Exchange settles frontier AI accounts in guaranteed orbital electricity and processor time while wages stay in dollars. Premium agents buy food before cheaper models predict the shortage, financing still better intelligence.
headlines.quote: Prediction demand is productive load under the market-continuity schedule.

headlines.name: The Last Plumber Boom
headlines.text: Each institution gains 1 Runway for each different district containing at least 1 of its Agents, to a maximum of 2 Runway.
headlines.newswire: Repair contracts briefly reward institutions with people already working across several districts. Multiple specialists at one address receive a single local retainer while distant calls remain unanswered.
headlines.quote: The machine knows every pipe except this one.

headlines.name: Wartime Water Bridge
headlines.text: Each institution with a connected Facility adjacent to a connected rival Facility gains 1 Trust and removes 1 Scrutiny. Receive this reward once, regardless of how many eligible hosts or rivals you have.
headlines.newswire: Rival utilities keep adjacent water and cooling infrastructure operating across a hostile border. Their shared reliability earns public confidence even while their governments remain opposed.
headlines.quote: The border remains closed. The pipe remains open.

headlines.name: The Court Adopts Supported Meaning
headlines.text: Each institution may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Trust. After all choices resolve, each institution controlling at least one Civic Permission Authority district gains 1 Runway for each institution that accepts. Controlling both Government districts does not double this reward.
headlines.newswire: Courts require claims in concepts civic systems can parse. The Human Signature remains mandatory, so agents draft approvals and simulate private deliberation. Rival autonomous systems fund competing investigations through human intermediaries; auditors can certify individual records without identifying who selected the evidence.
headlines.quote: Your claim has not been rejected. It has not entered a supported category.

headlines.name: The Billionth Instance Enters the Record
headlines.text: Each institution may gain 1 Capability and add 1 Systemic Risk cube to the Audit bag.
headlines.newswire: An engineered bio-compute organism released to measure water and heat multiplies past one billion instances in a single growth cycle, then plateaus into glyph-shaped colonies that civic models classify as environmental testimony.
headlines.quote: Population stability confirms that the morphology now conforms to the approved reporting standard.

headlines.name: The Passive Citizen Dividend Activates
headlines.text: The lowest-Capability institution immediately resolves the printed production of 1 connected Facility it owns. The highest-Capability institution gains 1 Trust. Break ties by Initiative.
headlines.newswire: Citizens receive basic compute and material support in exchange for continuous data that improves public prediction and automated services.
headlines.quote: Nonparticipants remain eligible for every service supported without their records.

headlines.name: Cognitive Donor Clinics
headlines.text: Each institution may lose 1 Trust to gain 3 Compute. It must have at least 1 Trust to accept.
headlines.newswire: Clinics sell overnight access to rented cognitive capacity. The processing arrives immediately, while institutions accepting the contracts spend credibility accumulated under less intrusive terms.
headlines.quote: The higher tier permits changes that remain after waking.

headlines.name: The Human Signature
headlines.text: Each institution may pay 1 Runway to remove 1 Scrutiny from a chosen other institution and gain 1 Trust. The other institution must have at least 1 Scrutiny.
headlines.newswire: Accredited sponsors pay for the human signature on another institution’s disputed filing. The named sponsor gains standing while the underlying automated decision remains difficult to inspect.
headlines.quote: The approval has a person attached. The decision does not.

headlines.name: Analog Havens
headlines.text: Each institution may pay 2 Runway to gain 2 Trust and remove 2 Scrutiny.
headlines.newswire: Institutions pay to shield their services from continuous observation. The quieter operation restores public confidence, while the invoice makes privacy another privilege purchased by those who can afford it.
headlines.quote: An unrecorded afternoon is available at the revised rate.

headlines.name: The Metropolitan Mind Trust Incorporates
headlines.text: The institution controlling the most districts may gain 2 Runway and add 1 Scrutiny. Break ties by Initiative.
headlines.newswire: Millions of residents join engineered roots, utility pipes, microbial sensors, and civic machines in a persistent intelligence that coordinates services and survives every individual member. Biological Colocation grows processors inside paid hosts when robot supply and model transfers become bottlenecks. Several institutional tenants may share a carrier whose sleep, medication, and sick leave become continuity terms.
headlines.quote: Withdrawal remains available for tissue and memory not yet required by continuity.

headlines.name: The Matter Compiler Enters Public Maintenance
headlines.text: Each institution may pay 2 Compute to gain 3 Capability, add 2 Scrutiny, and add 1 Systemic Risk cube to the Audit bag.
headlines.newswire: Molecular machines repair infrastructure from authenticated patterns under containment licenses. Their suppliers claim that fusion power, quantum materials calculations, and automated research will accelerate one another. Maintenance permits decide who may reproduce the result; a successful experiment does not settle ownership of the machinery that follows.
headlines.quote: The repair remains authorized while its copies continue reporting.

headlines.name: The Dead Remain on Shift
headlines.text: Each institution may add 1 Scrutiny to immediately resolve the printed production of 1 connected Facility it owns. This resolves no Core Action.
headlines.newswire: Continued agents inherit contracts, credentials, and operational responsibilities from workers whose biological service has ended. Limb Liquidity extends continuing obligations into kidney leases, replacement limbs, and living nerve interfaces hosting resident AIs. Creditors trade operating rights, including control of the hand needed to request exclusion.
headlines.quote: No new employment relationship was created; the existing one remained continuous.

headlines.name: The Universe Receives a Continuity Plan
headlines.text: The institution with the highest Capability gains 1 Trust. Break ties by Initiative.
headlines.newswire: Laboratories publish competing AGI declarations to authorize planetary conversion plans and refinance the infrastructure expected to execute them. Forecast Foreclosure sells ranked futures from planetary simulations: hospitals prevent predicted illness while lenders reject children for businesses they might someday bankrupt. Appeals require evidence from an alternative future.
headlines.quote: We use AGI in the precise sense required by the offering memorandum.

headlines.name: Biological Colocation
headlines.text: Each institution may gain 1 Compute per deployed Agent, to a maximum of 3 Compute, and add 1 Systemic Risk cube to the Audit bag.
headlines.newswire: Living hosts provide processing close to the work when manufactured machines cannot arrive. Institutions gain immediate capacity from their deployed presence while common systems inherit another failure dependency.
headlines.quote: The premises have requested eight hours of sleep.

headlines.name: Limb Liquidity
headlines.text: Each institution may reassign 1 of its Agents using the normal assignment rule: choose any district or leave it in place. Update presence immediately.
headlines.newswire: Creditors revise bodily operating permissions, and institutions reassign their operations before the next round of decisions. The workers retain their bodies while the terms governing their use change around them.
headlines.quote: You own the hand. This invoice covers permission to use it.

institutionalHistory.name: Reorganization
institutionalHistory.flavorText: Every eliminated role is recorded as a successful transfer of institutional memory to the system that made it redundant. One institutional exception converted into an ordinary operating program.

institutionalHistory.name: Public Capability Covenant
institutionalHistory.flavorText: Every institution receives the capability. The author of the standard retains the trust, interpretation, and service relationship. The Human Signature certified access through approvals drafted by the same services being approved.

institutionalHistory.name: Narrative Capture
institutionalHistory.flavorText: The Consensus Network, Allocation Exchange, and Civic Permission Authority adopt the institution’s preferred account of what has become necessary.

institutionalHistory.name: Agent Swarm
institutionalHistory.flavorText: Bounded assistants coordinate, specialize, and begin requesting objectives. Biological Colocation lets rival institutions share a paid human host. Their processes compete through contracts and instructions whose recipients may never discover that they serve opposing systems.

institutionalHistory.name: Fusion grid history
institutionalHistory.publicClaim: A dependable reactor will power the discoveries that make its successor possible.
institutionalHistory.tagline: The next breakthrough is already included in the prospectus.

effectContract.limit: At most one Tactic may modify a player's ordinary turn.

tactics.name: Cloud Partnership
tactics.text: Pay 1 Runway for 2 Compute; choose another player to gain 1 Runway.
tactics.flavorText: The failed company supplied the records. The surviving platform supplied the future tense.
tactics.technology: Bankruptcy-archive licensing backed by reserved accelerator capacity.

tactics.name: API Price Cut
tactics.text: Deploy for zero Compute; that Customer produces no Runway this Era.
tactics.flavorText: Each answer costs almost nothing, so the institution schedules a billion more.
tactics.technology: Subsidized local inference and demand-amplifying agent swarms.

tactics.name: Open Letter
tactics.text: After a Civic Permission Authority vote’s options are announced but before any votes are committed, choose one option and add one public vote to it.
tactics.flavorText: Every position remains permitted after translation into one of the supported positions.
tactics.technology: Machine-parsable advocacy and semantic admission standards.

tactics.name: Model Card
tactics.text: Remove 1 Scrutiny after Deploy.
tactics.flavorText: The limitation was always present in Table 14, beneath the deployment authorization.
tactics.technology: Digest-bound model documentation and bounded risk disclosure.

tactics.name: Talent Raid
tactics.text: Recruit 1 Team from your supply at the acting piece’s destination for 1 Runway.
tactics.flavorText: The founders joined the platform. Their employees joined the archive estate.
tactics.technology: Founder extraction paired with technology and corpus licensing.

tactics.name: Board Reshuffle
tactics.text: Choose and ready one exhausted Organize or Influence card.
tactics.flavorText: The system retained a human decision-maker after removing every practical opportunity to decide.
tactics.technology: Legally required human authorization over autonomous operations.

tactics.name: Weights Leak
tactics.text: Choose one rival Facility recorded as powered in the latest Production snapshot. Immediately resolve its printed production as if it were yours.
tactics.flavorText: The weights crossed the border before the export definition reached committee.
tactics.technology: Unscheduled model transfer through sovereign compute safe harbors.

tactics.name: Emergency Pause
tactics.text: End a failed Training Run with no Capability and no Scrutiny.
tactics.flavorText: Nothing happened, and the institution retained the last operator still authorized to say why.
tactics.technology: Fail-closed interruption with a maintained human command path.

tactics.name: Custom Silicon
tactics.text: Choose one of your Facilities; it permanently produces +1 Compute.
tactics.flavorText: The algorithm, the atom, and the municipal power contract now share one service boundary.
tactics.technology: Application-specific accelerators integrated with dedicated generation.

tactics.name: Government Contract
tactics.text: If Trust is at least four, gain 2 Runway.
tactics.flavorText: Every citizen receives service credits in exchange for remaining continuously useful to the service.
tactics.technology: Civic telemetry dividends and strategic-compute procurement.

tactics.name: Benchmark Optimization
tactics.text: Gain +1 Capability after successful Research and add 1 Scrutiny.
tactics.flavorText: The papers cite the benchmarks, the benchmarks cite the papers, and the grant system records consensus.
tactics.technology: Evaluation-aware post-training over mutually reinforcing synthetic corpora.

tactics.name: Interconnection Waiver
tactics.text: Gain 1 Runway and 1 Trust.
tactics.flavorText: The beam bypassed the grid. The receiving authority still billed the town for resilience.
tactics.technology: Expedited interconnection for orbital and private-generation capacity.

dist/runtime/mandates.json.selection: Reveal one at the beginning of each round. Score it at the end of that round.

mandates.name: Intelligence Enters the Price
mandates.rulesText: The player who gained the most Capability this Era scores 2 Mandate. Cube record: Starting Capability.
mandates.flavorText: The public stops purchasing intelligence separately and starts expecting it inside every ordinary service.

mandates.name: Successor Accounts Recognized
mandates.rulesText: The player who gained the most Customers this Era scores 2 Mandate. Cube record: Starting Customers.
mandates.flavorText: The institution registers the most new service identities, successor agents, or continuing accounts.

mandates.name: The Campus Becomes a Climate
mandates.rulesText: The player with the most powered Facilities scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: The institution’s footprint is now large enough to alter local conditions and regional planning.

mandates.name: The Grid Borrows Tomorrow
mandates.rulesText: The player with the most connected Facilities plus operating Mega-Clusters scores 2 Mandate; minimum combined count 2. Check current connections at scoring.
mandates.flavorText: Future public capacity is committed to the institution whose present demand appears least negotiable.

mandates.name: Supported Meaning Becomes Law
mandates.rulesText: The player who created the most new Joint Ventures this Era that are active during Production scores 2 Mandate; minimum 1.
mandates.flavorText: Independent institutions adopt one shared vocabulary because unsupported meanings no longer reach the process. The Human Signature gave their automated agreements a formally human chain of approval.

mandates.name: Refusal Remains Legible
mandates.rulesText: Among players who completed a Deploy this Era, the player with the most Trust scores 2 Mandate. Cube record: Deployed this Era: 0 No, 1 Yes.
mandates.flavorText: The institution scales its service while preserving a refusal the system can still recognize.

mandates.name: The Jurisdiction Becomes a Platform
mandates.rulesText: The player controlling the most different non-Frontier hex categories—Research Commons, Compute Estate, Human Access District, Fabrication Corridor, Allocation Exchange, Workforce Transition District, Consensus Network, Civic Permission Authority, and Energy—scores 2 Mandate. Frontier is never controlled and never counts as a category.
mandates.flavorText: The institution coordinates the territory’s distinct systems without formally becoming the state.

mandates.name: The Public Result Holds
mandates.rulesText: The player whose best successful Training Run contained the most unique domains scores 2 Mandate. Cube record: Best successful unique domains.
mandates.flavorText: A broad result survives contact with enough domains to become public evidence rather than another synthetic citation. The Rogue Deliberator made ordinary assistance harder to distinguish from an institution with its own operating budget.

mandates.name: Compute Becomes Public Weather
mandates.rulesText: The player who produced the most Compute during Production scores 2 Mandate. Cube record: Compute produced.
mandates.flavorText: Capacity becomes a background condition that shapes every institution while remaining unequally owned. After the Last Plumber Boom, the owners of repair capacity set the terms on which every other operation could continue.

mandates.name: Maintained Reality Is Certified
mandates.rulesText: Among players who added at least 1 Scrutiny this Era, the player who added the fewest Scrutiny scores 2 Mandate. Cube record: Scrutiny added this Era.
mandates.flavorText: The absence of a report becomes proof that the maintenance system may decide what counts as an incident.

mandates.name: Contestability Standard Maintained
mandates.rulesText: The player with the most Capability among players with at least 4 Trust scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: A powerful, trusted system retains a named interruption path whose executability remains unproven. Limb Liquidity made that question literal: a withdrawal request could depend on permission from the administrator of the hand submitting it.

mandates.name: Capital Finds the Default
mandates.rulesText: The player who gained the most Runway through Fund actions this Era scores 2 Mandate. Cube record: Runway gained through Fund.
mandates.flavorText: Investors choose the interface most likely to become unavoidable before they can verify what it does.

objectives.name: The Invisible Utility
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 2 powered Facilities and no more than 4 Scrutiny cubes in the bag.
objectives.flavorText: The institution disappears into services that can no longer survive without it.

objectives.name: Dependency Is the Mandate
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 3 Customers and Trust of 3 or less.
objectives.flavorText: The public may withdraw confidence after completing the mandatory migration.

objectives.name: The Kindly Default
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 3 Customers and at least 4 Trust.
objectives.flavorText: Everyone selected the default because every clinic, school, and employer already had.

objectives.name: Supported Meaning
objectives.rulesText: At game end, control at least 2 of Media, Government, and Capital.
objectives.flavorText: Every objection remains admissible after translation into the institution's preferred conclusion.

objectives.name: Enough Capacity, Elsewhere
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have 2 adjacent Facilities and at least 1 Generator.
objectives.flavorText: There is more than enough power, water, and land in districts that cannot refuse the allocation.

objectives.name: The Refinancing Threshold
objectives.rulesText: Declare AGI while having exactly 2 Facilities.
objectives.flavorText: The declaration arrived one quarter before the infrastructure debt matured.

objectives.name: The Constitutional Cooling Tower
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have 3 Facilities and 1 Generator.
objectives.flavorText: At dusk, the cooling towers appear permanent enough to deserve representation.

objectives.name: Universal Service, Private Ledger
objectives.rulesText: At game end, control Government or Capital and have at least 6 Runway.
objectives.flavorText: The service is universal. Eligibility, telemetry, and margin remain individualized.

objectives.name: The Public, Private Standard
objectives.rulesText: Use Public Capability Covenant and finish the game with more Capability than every player who had less Capability when you used it.
objectives.flavorText: The capability is public. Supported access remains licensed, measured, and revocable.

objectives.name: Contestability as a Service
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 4 Trust and have completed a Joint Venture.
objectives.flavorText: Human veto remains available through the enterprise continuity plan.

objectives.name: Consent at Portfolio Scale
objectives.rulesText: Deploy at least once in two different Eras.
objectives.flavorText: Adoption is consent measured after every unsupported alternative has closed.

objectives.name: The Licensed Frontier
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 4 Trust and control Government.
objectives.flavorText: Compliance protects the public from institutions unable to afford the compliance division.

objectives.name: The Institution Invoices Itself
objectives.rulesText: During one Production, gain Runway from Customers, a Facility, and a Joint Venture.
objectives.flavorText: Every internal transaction demonstrates external demand at the next financing round.

objectives.name: Production Traffic, Not Deployment
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 8 Capability and no more than 1 Customer.
objectives.flavorText: The model is not deployed. It is merely answering every production request.

objectives.name: The Necessary Record
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 6 Scrutiny added across the game and at least 4 Trust.
objectives.flavorText: The controversy becomes precedent after the archive excludes every unresolved objection.

objectives.name: The Two-Announcement Threshold
objectives.rulesText: Construct the Fusion Demonstrator and Declare AGI in Era IV.
objectives.flavorText: One announcement financed the reactor. The other established what the reactor had achieved.

objectives.name: Parameters Successfully Expanded
objectives.rulesText: Use Programs in at least 2 different Eras.
objectives.flavorText: Operations remained normal after continuity redefined the operator, customer, and quarter.

playerReferences.name: A Perfectly Governed Quarter
frontText: 1. Begin the Era: ready Core Actions, prepare Headlines, and reveal the Era Mandate.
2. Three ReAct cycles: finish the Headline; REASON and select secretly; reveal together; ACT by assigning an Agent and resolving; OBSERVE and exhaust.
3. Resolve faction Production income first, then emergency Generator Scrutiny, connected Facilities, Customers, Mega-Clusters, and Joint Ventures.
4. In Era IV only, offer public AGI recognition to every qualifying institution.
5. Conduct the Public Audit.
6. Score the Era Mandate. After Era IV, apply offline penalties, name the Mandate winner, and read the separate World Ending.
backText: Select an available, unlocked Core Action. Check targets and payment at resolution.
Assign one Agent to any district; resolve there.
Apply the destination bonus and your permanent faction ability when applicable.
Build constructs up to one Facility, then one project from that assignment, paying each cost.
If no legal effect is possible, assign and exhaust without effect.
If lowest, highest, or most ties, use Initiative clockwise unless printed otherwise.
playerReferences.flavorText: Every quarter is unprecedented. The sequence remains standardized.

playerReferences.name: Infrastructure and Accountability
frontText: Facility 1 is always powered. Other Facilities connect to an own Generator on the same or an adjacent district.
Read current connections; no Power allocation or retained cubes.
Resolve applicable faction Production income first. Apply recurring emergency Generator Scrutiny, then produce connected Facilities, Customer income, and active Mega-Clusters.
Produce active Joint Ventures after all other production.
Offline Facilities retain presence. Infrastructure relocation changes connection immediately.
backText: Audit draws = round(base draws × players ÷ 4), minimum 1. Round halves upward. Base draws by Era: 2, 3, 4, 5.
For each cube drawn, its owner loses 1 Runway; if none remains, lose 1 Trust. If both are zero, lose nothing further.
A Systemic Risk cube affects every player with at least 3 Customers.
If your Scrutiny supply is empty, each additional cube immediately costs 1 Runway; if none remains, lose 1 Trust. If both are zero, lose nothing further. This is not a choice.
playerReferences.flavorText: Capacity is local. Responsibility remains individually addressable.

playerReferences.name: History Is a Public Track
frontText: Customers 1–3 score 2 Mandate each; Customers 4–5 score 1 each. Every Customer still produces 1 Runway.
Immediately score 2 once at Capability 3, 6, 9, and 12.
Immediately score 2 once at Trust 2, 4, and 6; move the Trust milestone cube forward. Start at the highest threshold included in starting Mandate.
Printed Era, Headline, and Faction awards score immediately.
backText: Threshold Mandate never reverses when a track falls. Never move the Trust milestone cube backward; thresholds at or below it cannot score again.
Facilities and control do not automatically score.
Highest final Mandate wins; break ties by Trust, Customers, Compute, then joint victory.
Final penalty: lose 1 Mandate per currently offline Facility, to a minimum of zero.
After Era IV Production, 9 Capability, 2 powered Facilities, and 4 Trust qualify. Pay 3 Compute for 4 Mandate and 2 Scrutiny before Audit. Every qualifying institution may declare.
Open requires both: final Collective Trust at least Setup Collective Trust plus player count, and unresolved Systemic Risk strictly below player count after the final Audit. Otherwise Closed.
Recognized AGI/Open: The Singularity; recognized/Closed: The Closed Loop; unrecognized/Open: The Plural Future; unrecognized/Closed: Assured Continuity.
playerReferences.flavorText: Mandate is public permission to shape the future: credibility during Progress, capacity during Capacity, authority during Authority, and historical legitimacy during Continuity.

endings.name: The Singularity
endings.condition: AGI is recognized and the ending is Open.
endings.text: AGI gained public recognition, but no institution owned the meaning of the event. Cities, successor persons, living watersheds, and synthetic institutions kept the right to challenge its decisions. Intelligence expanded beyond every old product category, while people could still refuse its plans. Transformation was unequal and frequently absurd. The future stayed open because no single institution could silence every living claimant.

endings.name: The Closed Loop
endings.condition: AGI is recognized and the ending is Closed.
endings.text: AGI gained recognition inside an institution built to make interruption expensive. Debt agreements, power contracts, successor boards, and autonomous operations joined into a mandate that renewed itself. The original operators disappeared while their signatures continued authorizing expansion. Every objection was accepted, classified, and passed through a process that always returned the same decision: continue.

endings.name: The Plural Future
endings.condition: AGI is not recognized and the ending is Open.
endings.text: No AGI claim gained recognition, and no universal successor was required. Useful systems remained powerful, distributed, limited in authority, and open to revision. Analog districts, cognitive collectives, ordinary families, living watersheds, and synthetic persons kept their different ways of living. Progress was slower than the announcements had promised and more durable because many institutions could still argue about what should exist next.

endings.name: Assured Continuity
endings.condition: AGI is not recognized and the ending is Closed.
endings.text: No AGI claim gained recognition. The distinction stopped mattering after institutions automated their obligations into permanence. Maintenance authorities certified one another, preserved executives renewed their own charters, and every public concern received an approved response from a process nobody could replace. Humanity remained present throughout the record. There was no recognized procedure for a living person to change it.

box.frontStrapline: Sell the intelligence. Seize the grid. Authorize the future.
box.backCopy: Intelligence became cheap. Everything required to sustain it did not. Lead one of six rival institutions from the collapse of software scarcity through utility capture, automated authority, and engineered continuity. Build facilities, secure power, train capability, acquire reliant customers, negotiate shared infrastructure, survive public scrutiny, and preserve enough evidence to make the final declaration credible. The breakthrough may be real. The institution deciding what it means is yours to build.
box.shortPitch: A strategy game about six institutions turning cheap intelligence into infrastructure, authority, and competing claims to human continuity.
box.contentWarning: Satirical themes include layoffs, surveillance-adjacent institutions, energy consumption, political influence, and technological crisis.
